Players this season

Each player's competitions this season, added up. Every total is the sum of the rows above it, and every competition opens the page its row was copied from, so any figure here can be checked against the competition it came from. Win rate is worked out again from the added-up sets, not averaged, and is a dash where no set was decided. Ratings are shown for each competition and never added up, and neither are the things that only make sense inside one competition: streaks, partners, opponents and share of the team's games. Each competition's page has those.

People are matched by the name their competition pages print, across competitions, so two people who share a name share a list here until the club's settings tell them apart. Every row names its competition and team. Only the competitions on the front page are counted.

Listed by name. Matches in one competition and matches in another are not the same tennis, so this is a record of how much somebody played, not a ranking.
